sql.if: AND (client_accounts.display_name LIKE ESCAPE '!' OR client_accounts.phone LIKE ESCAPE '!')

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM client_accounts WHERE client_accounts.store_id = #{storeId} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sales_sessions WHERE sales_sessions.client_account_id = client_accounts.id AND sales_sessions.store_id = client_accounts.store_id AND sales_sessions.created_at >= #{from} AND sales_sessions.created_at < #{to})

SELECT client_accounts.id, client_accounts.display_name AS displayName, CASE WHEN client_accounts.phone IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CONCAT(LEFT(client_accounts.phone, 3), '***', RIGHT(client_accounts.phone, 3)) END AS maskedPhone, COUNT(sales_sessions.id) AS sessionCount, MAX(sales_sessions.created_at) AS lastVisitedAt, COALESCE(SUM(payments.amount), 0) AS totalPaid FROM client_accounts LEFT JOIN sales_sessions ON sales_sessions.client_account_id = client_accounts.id LEFT JOIN payments ON payments.sales_session_id = sales_sessions.id AND payments.status = 'PAID' WHERE client_accounts.store_id = #{storeId} AND client_accounts.id = #{customerId} GROUP BY client_accounts.id, client_accounts.display_name, client_accounts.phone
SELECT phone FROM client_accounts WHERE store_id=#{storeId} AND id=#{customerId}

SELECT sales_sessions.public_id AS publicId, dining_tables.code AS tableCode, sales_sessions.status, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE orders.sales_session_id=sales_sessions.id) AS orderCount, payments.status AS paymentStatus, payments.amount AS paymentAmount, unpaid_records.status AS unpaidStatus, unpaid_records.amount AS unpaidAmount, sales_sessions.created_at AS openedAt, sales_sessions.closed_at AS closedAt FROM sales_sessions LEFT JOIN dining_tables ON dining_tables.id=sales_sessions.table_id LEFT JOIN payments ON payments.sales_session_id=sales_sessions.id LEFT JOIN unpaid_records ON unpaid_records.sales_session_id=sales_sessions.id WHERE sales_sessions.store_id=#{storeId} AND sales_sessions.client_account_id=#{customerId} ORDER BY sales_sessions.created_at DESC, sales_sessions.id DESC
